parameters.name: AggregatorId
parameters.description:
The aggregator ID.

For information about how to obtain an aggregator ID, see [ListAggregators](~~255797~~).

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The number of the page to return.

The value must be a positive integer. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: Regions
parameters.description: The region ID. Separate multiple region IDs with a comma (,).

parameters.name: ResourceDeleted
parameters.description:
The status of the resource. Valid values:

- 0: The resource is deleted.

- 1 (default): The resource is not deleted.

parameters.name: ResourceTypes
parameters.description: The resource type. Separate multiple resource types with a comma (,).
